verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity's core verification lifecycle (create session, capture document/selfie, retrieve results, override status, blocklist, webhooks) is exposed via API and documented with curl examples, and an official CLI and MCP server exist for programmatic/agent access. However, some UI-configured aspects (branding/logo/color setup, verification flow builder/static links) are described as dashboard-configured rather than fully API-driven, and no OpenAPI spec was found to confirm full parity. missing for 10: explicit API endpoints for branding/flow configuration done via dashboard, confirmed OpenAPI spec showing full UI/API parity, independent confirmation that all dashboard actions (e.g., manual review UI actions) have API equivalents.
